recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31812 unless BRR reopens a broader Substance/SubstanceDefinition policy question beyond this published tracker.

initial_application: Commit e51759e1f5aa20553bc8b9f3ab3f933f4efe3581 applied the request by removing the Substance targetProfile from Ingredient.substance.code and Ingredient.substance.strength.referenceStrength.substance. The current source preserves that result.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini makes Ingredient and SubstanceDefinition active resources and maps the old MedicinalProductIngredient artifact to Ingredient. Current SubstanceDefinition and Substance narrative distinguishes definitional substance descriptions from actual instance or batch substances. Confluence contains BRR minute references to the tracker and documentation request, and the precise Zulip search found no issue-specific contrary discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because no source edit is needed in current FHIR core.
